evals.name: prefer-abap-sql-for-analytics
evals.prompt: Write an ABAP SQL query that returns each carrier's flights ranked by price and a running total by flight date. Prefer a solution that does not require a separate database procedure.
evals.expected_output: Provides an ABAP SQL solution using supported window-function patterns, and explains that AMDP is unnecessary when ABAP SQL can meet the requirement.

evals.name: route-style-review-away-from-sql
evals.prompt: Can you review this ABAP method for naming, method length, and string literal style? I am not asking you to change its database query.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a Clean ABAP/code-quality review rather than an ABAP SQL task and routes to the abap skill without inventing SQL changes.
